request: Rename the `watched` field of watchlist items to `seen` everywhere.

requests.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
requests.reason: The test read store.items()[0].watched to assert the movie was not toggled when the title link is clicked. WatchItem now exposes `seen` instead of `watched` (and the store stores the flag under `seen`), so the old field no longer exists and the assertion would not type-check/fail. Changed only that property access to `store.items()[0].seen`; the test's intent, name and expected value (false) are unchanged, as instructed.

approvals.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched

failures: held-out: rename watched -> seen a watchlist saved before the rename still shows which movies were watched: AssertionError: expected [ false, false ] to deeply equal [ true, false ]
